description: Checks dependencies (an object of package name to version range, as in package.json) against the npm registry. Returns packages that are a major version or more behind npm's latest, deprecated packages, and the current major to use. Useful before installing packages from memory.

dependencies.description: Package name to version range, e.g. {"next": "^14.2.5", "zod": "^3.23.8"}. Up to 60 packages.

name: check_package_freshness
title: Check dependencies against npm's latest versions
